note_tsim: Shows the position of the French and American troops and batteries during the Siege of Yorktown
Shows scale bar at lower left, "Scale of Yards"

Compare the printed map "To His Excellency Gen'l Washington, commander in chief of the armies of the United States of America, this plan of the investment of York and Gloucester has been surveyed and laid down" in the Library of Congress Rochambeau Collection (Call Number G3884.Y6S3 1782 .B3) engraved by R. Scot in Philadelphia and published in 1782 (and from which a reproduction was produced in 1981 for the Defense Mapping Agency Bicentennial commemorative memento of the Battle of Yorktown see Library of Congress Call Number G3884.Y6S3 1781 .B3 1981 for an example). The printed map shows the lines of the British, lacking on this manuscript example.

Copy at Add Ms 27,715.13. Manuscript "13" added in pencil at upper right. Manuscript annotation in black ink at upper right, "Presented by Colonel Sir Augustus Frazer K.C.B. R.A.". Shows "335" in ink in margin at lower right. Laid on archival tissue. Verso shows additional titles in ink (twice); "American Plan of York Town Virginia". Green circular label to verso showing "18". White label to verso showing "DRAWER 30 SECTION 3". Blue label to verso showing "A 30/17", and annotation repeated in pencil. Yellow circular label showing "YO" (crossed through). Additional label showing "533".
